name: Qwen3.5-4B-Hmm
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B: 8 full GQA layers (kv heads 4, head_dim 256) and 24 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 4.66 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-20. CAVEATS: Task=decision (LoRA r=32 merged; single forward pass over letter options, excluded from worth-running ranking). Trained on ~30k questions, English, 768-token prompts. The card is unusually honest: it says Hmm is a few points BEHIND Jev 1.13 on every decision benchmark, and it loses HellaSwag 0.722 vs 0.765 and phishing 0.629 vs 0.648. Synthetic training labels were LLM-written and unchecked.
